page.subtitle: Perimeter register, reconciliation, legal and economic transfers, Day-1 contract positions and the change-controlled perimeter. Nothing here is determined by the platform — it records what accountable people report, with evidence.

register.emptyHint: Items appear here when they are registered. After the baseline is approved, every addition goes through change control.
register.addHint: Once the perimeter baseline is approved the item is held as Pending and a change request is raised; it only enters scope when that change is approved and applied.

item.name: Name
item.historyHint: Every change to the item is kept as a numbered version.
item.editHint: Descriptive fields only. Disposition, site and entities change through a scope change (change-controlled after baseline); transfer status changes through transfer commands.

refusal.consentRequiredByClass: The specialist classified this contract as needing a consent or novation: the consent need follows that class. Re-assess the transferability to change it.

scope.heldForChange: Held as Pending — change request {code} raised for approval.
scope.justificationAddHint: Required once the perimeter baseline is approved: it becomes the rationale of the change request.
scope.title: Change the scope of {code}
scope.baselinedHint: This item is in the approved baseline: the change is raised as a change request with an impact assessment, and nothing changes until the change is approved and applied.
scope.hint: No baseline is approved yet, so the change is applied directly and recorded in the item history.
scope.narrativeHint: Describe known impacts per area. Areas you leave empty stay "Assessment pending — specialist".
scope.applyEffect2: Approved: the requested disposition, site and entities are applied and the item leaves Pending.
scope.applyEffect3: Rejected or withdrawn: the item keeps its current scope and the pending change is closed.
scope.pendingBanner: A perimeter change is pending under {code} ({status}). The item stays Pending until the change is decided and its outcome applied.

impact.recordHint: The platform lists the linked records it can see per area; the narrative is yours. Empty areas remain "Assessment pending — specialist".
impact.title: Impact assessment
impact.hint: Assessments are append-only: each change or review adds a new one.

transfer.historyExplain: Legal transfer (title) and economic transfer (benefits and risks) are tracked separately; each command is kept here with the evidence count at that moment.
transfer.title: Transfer (legal vs economic)
transfer.hint: Two independent aspects: a legal transfer does not imply the economic one, or the reverse.
transfer.notSelf: The person who reported the transfer cannot verify it.

effect.plan: The {aspect} transfer is planned for the date given.
effect.start: The {aspect} transfer is marked in progress.
effect.report_transferred: The {aspect} transfer is reported as done and waits for evidence verification by someone else.
effect.block: The {aspect} transfer is marked blocked with your reason.
effect.mark_not_applicable: The {aspect} transfer is recorded as not applicable, with your reason.
effect.determine_not_applicable: Specialist determination: the {aspect} transfer of this included / shared item is not applicable. Your basis is recorded; the item still transfers on the other aspect.
effect.mark_not_applicable_change_request: The item is in the approved baseline: a change request is raised with its impact assessment. The {aspect} transfer changes only once the approved request is applied.

transfer.otherAspectUnchanged: The other aspect is not changed.
transfer.rejectTitle: Reject the evidence for the {aspect} transfer of {code}
transfer.verifyEffect: The transfer becomes Transferred — verified against the linked evidence.
transfer.rejectEffect: The transfer returns to In progress; the reporter must provide better evidence.
transfer.notApplicableSpecialist: That one aspect of an included / shared item does not transfer is a specialist determination (Finance, Legal or the functional approver — not the item owner). An item that does not transfer at all is reclassified.
transfer.changeRequested: Change request {code} raised — the transfer changes once it is approved and applied.

refusal.notApplicableSpecialist: That an aspect of an included / shared item does not transfer is a specialist determination (Finance, Legal or the functional approver, not the item owner) — or, for an item that does not transfer at all, a reclassification.
refusal.notApplicableInScope: The other aspect is already not applicable: an included / shared item always transfers on at least one aspect. Reclassify the item (Excluded) through the scope change instead.
refusal.notApplicableAfterBaseline: The item is in the approved baseline: the transfer manager raises this as a change request (impact assessment, approval, then apply).
refusal.notApplicableNotInScope: The item is not included or shared: its transfer commands are the transfer manager's.

day1.explain: For every contract in scope without a granted consent: a specialist classification, an interim arrangement and named owners for service, billing and SLA (AT-08).
day1.title: Day-1 contract positions

recon.scopeNote: Counts cover only the items you can see. Verified means verified against evidence by someone other than the reporter.
recon.findingsHint: Gaps to close before the perimeter can be approved or the transfer can be verified.

issue.transfer_not_applicable: Transfer not applicable on an in-scope item

recon.categoriesHint: Every category must either have items or a recorded review concluding none belong in the perimeter.
recon.reviewHint: Record who reviewed the category and why no item belongs in the perimeter (or what was found).

versions.explain: A perimeter version freezes the register at a point in time. Once approved it is the baseline: later changes go through change control.
versions.proposeEffect1: The current register (items visible to the project) is frozen as a proposed version.
versions.proposeEffect2: Blocking findings (for example unassessed categories) prevent the proposal; warnings are kept with the version.
versions.blockers: The version cannot be proposed yet:
versions.approveEffect1: The version becomes the approved perimeter baseline, citing the governance decision.
versions.approveEffect2: Later additions and scope changes need an impact assessment and an approved change request.
versions.notSelf: The proposer cannot approve their own version.
versions.rejectEffect: The version is rejected with your reason; the register stays as it is.
versions.decisionHint: The final committee decision raised for gate G1 FOR this perimeter version (raise the G1 paper from the committee with this version as its subject). A decision raised for no record or for another record, or that already approved another version, is not offered: one decision backs one version.

refusal.decisionAlreadyUsed: The selected decision already approved another perimeter version: one decision backs one version. A new version needs a new committee decision.
refusal.decisionOtherSubject: The selected decision was raised for another record; it cannot approve this perimeter version.
refusal.decisionNoSubject: The selected decision was not raised for this perimeter version: a G1 paper must name the version it approves. Raise a paper for this version.

sites.name: Name
sites.explain: Sites group perimeter items by location.

consents.specialistOnly: Not required is a specialist determination: record its basis.
consents.day1Effect: The Day-1 position of the linked contract is recalculated.
consents.evidenceHint: Where the response is held (link the document as evidence on the record).
consents.hint: Consents, novations and assignments needed from counterparties.

contract.classifyHint: Specialist classification with its basis. The platform never infers transferability.
contract.interimHint: Interim arrangement and the people accountable for service, billing and SLA until the consent is granted.
contract.title: Contract position
contract.hint: Needed for Day-1 when the contract cannot transfer on day one (AT-08).

agreements.label: Label
agreements.explain: Agreement labels are kept exactly as found in the source; their expansion stays unconfirmed until the owner or legal reviewer confirms it.
agreements.expansionHint: A proposal only — it is shown as unconfirmed until confirmed with a basis.
agreements.title: Title
agreements.partiesHint: One party per line, as "Name — role".
agreements.createHint: Stage starts at Identified. Dates, obligations and terms are recorded as they become known — never assumed.

effect.agree_in_principle: The agreement is recorded as agreed in principle (not signed).
effect.record_signing: The signing is recorded with its date.
effect.record_effective: The agreement is recorded as effective from the date given.
effect.terminate: The agreement is recorded as terminated, with your reason.
effect.record_expiry: The agreement is recorded as expired on the date given.

agreements.signingRule: Signing needs an assigned legal reviewer and the executed copy, or active signing evidence, linked to this record.
agreements.notEsignature: This records a signing that happened elsewhere; it is not an electronic signature.
agreements.confirmExpansionHint: Only the agreement owner or legal reviewer can confirm. The basis is kept in the audit trail.
agreements.versionHint: Versions are append-only; link the draft document as evidence.

refusal.legalReviewerNotLegal: The legal reviewer of an agreement must hold a legal role in this project.

recon.no_transfer_plan: No transfer mechanism and/or planned effective date.
recon.not_applicable_both: Included / shared item with neither a legal nor an economic transfer — reclassify it through a scope change or plan the transfer.
recon.not_applicable_legal: Legal transfer determined not applicable — the item transfers on the economic aspect only.
recon.not_applicable_economic: Economic transfer determined not applicable — the item transfers on the legal aspect only.
recon.consent_outstanding: Consent required and not granted, with no interim arrangement.
recon.pending_without_resolution: Pending item without an owner, a resolution path and a target resolution gate (G1-C03).
recon.change_request_pending: A scope change awaits the change-request decision.

change.attributes: The change modifies the scope attributes of {item};
change.into_scope: The change moves {item} into the transferring scope;
change.out_of_scope: The change moves {item} out of the transferring scope;

financial.reassess: the carve-out financial statements / reporting perimeter must be reassessed — Assessment pending — specialist (Finance).
financial.reassess_balance_sheet: the carve-out financial statements / reporting perimeter (balance-sheet item) must be reassessed — Assessment pending — specialist (Finance).

impact.no_scope_change: No change to the transferring scope.

valuation.pending: Valuation assumptions may change — Assessment pending — specialist (Finance / Corporate Development).

agreements.not_visible: Agreement register not visible to you.
agreements.no_instrument: No transfer instrument linked yet — TBD.

tsa.not_visible: TSA register not visible to you.
tsa.linked: TSA services linked through the item's agreement: {codes}.
tsa.shared: Shared item: a TSA or an approved enduring arrangement is required — TBD (Assessment pending — specialist).

readiness.not_visible: Readiness register not visible to you.
readiness.linked: Day-1 readiness checks of the same site to revisit: {codes}.
readiness.no_checks: No Day-1 readiness checks exist for this site yet — checklist to be defined.

schedule.linked: Milestones of the item's workstream that may move: {codes}.
schedule.none: No open milestone in the workstream.
schedule.no_workstream: No workstream assigned — schedule impact TBD.

budget.linked: Budget lines of the item's workstream to review: {codes}.
budget.pending: Separation / standalone cost effect — Assessment pending — specialist (Finance).

transaction.pending: Transaction perimeter (JV scope, CPs, signing / closing documents) — Assessment pending — specialist (Legal / Corporate Development).
transaction.none: No change to the transaction perimeter.

history.created_pending: Created — held Pending under change control
